assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Premium mature Cyberpunk RED 2045 RPG catalogue illustration, detailed hand-drawn CEL SHADING. Fine varied ink contour and crisp large shadow planes, realistic adult proportions and engineered construction, secondary reflected-light shapes, clear differentiation of cloth, metal, polymer and glass. Restrained local wear, materially convincing details concentrated around the subject, softer lower-contrast atmospheric background. Lived-in retrofuturist city after economic collapse, repaired practical technology. Cinematic light, readable main subject and generous safe margins. Never cute or toy-like, no thick uniform icon outline, no photoreal photograph or glossy 3D render, no uniform grain, no unreadable pseudo-text, no letters, logos, watermark, borders or UI. 3:2 scene of a modest converted cargo-container apartment in a dense cyberpunk district. A narrow bed, compact kitchenette, repaired ventilation duct, folding table, one worn chair and a window overlooking stacked containers and towers. Personal but economical, no people; inhabited practical space, believable room layout, clear foreground and depth. Warm task lamp against cool evening city.
